column2: The business sector covers the whole economy less public administration, non-profit institutions and the rental value of owner-occupied dwellings.
This combines the business establishments of the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 21.
Multifactor productivity measures the efficiency with which all inputs are used in production. It is the ratio of real gross domestic product (GDP) to combined labour and capital inputs.
